description: Port of ESLint's `no-magic-numbers` (https://eslint.org/docs/latest/rules/no-magic-numbers). Flags numeric literals (with a leading unary +/-) except variable initialisers, object properties, member assignments, parseInt radixes and JSX containers. Options are declared in the `options` define (the rule's defaults); a variant is a config patch.

ignore.description: numbers as their JSON text, bigints as written ("-100n")
